summary.name: Google DeepMind
summary.one_liner: Google DeepMind is the AI research lab's homepage, showcasing its Gemini-based models and research across audio, video, image, music, robotics, and science.
use_cases: find ai tools for video, image, and music generation
summary.what_it_does: The page is a homepage for Google DeepMind, listing its AI models and projects in a slideshow format. Featured items include Genie 4, described as a new generation of world simulation, and several Gemini-based models such as real-time audio models, a Gemini Image model, a music generation model, and a video generation model. It also mentions a coding and agents model, a robotics intelligence model, an open-model family, and work on using AI to understand the human genome and for scientific discovery. The page text is mostly headlines and short taglines, so it gives few concrete specifications, pricing, or usage details.
notable: Genie 4 world simulation model featured on homepage
Gemini-based models across audio, image, music, and video
Open models built to maximize intelligence-per-parameter
Research on AI for the human genome and scientific discovery
caveats: Page text is mostly headlines and taglines, with few concrete details on features or availability
